title: Preprocessing, leakage and randomness in scikit-learn
scope: Evaluation of scikit-learn estimators and pipelines
summary: Separate training and evaluation data before learning transformations. Fit preprocessing on training data only and reuse it for testing. A Pipeline reduces application errors and leakage. Document how random_state is controlled: integers and RNG objects behave differently.
interpretation: The demo fits StandardScaler inside the SGD training pipeline; the split remains fixed and each training run uses a predefined seed.
limitations: Cross-validation design requires reviewing interactions between estimators, splits and RNGs. The demo does not represent cross-validation or population evaluation.
